name: 🧩 Pluggable Chrome Architecture
description:
Architettura chrome pluggable: `ChromeHost` con regioni left/right/top/bottom, provider built-in, migrazione workspace tree in `WorkspacesContainerProvider`, dynamic action registry, host API per actions/overlay/regions, placeholder token system, plugin semplici da config e runtime WASM.

═══ THE RULE THIS FEATURE SERVES — read before any widget or component work ═══

Antonio, 2026-08-28, named as the project's FIRST RULE: **a DOM-like structure you can place anywhere, where no other developer handles clicks, surfaces or mouse-move — it MUST be internal logic, abstracted.** It applies to every widget and component, present and future.

The test: `Terminal::new("name")` dropped into a dock, an overlay or a plugin panel still selects text, reports mouse to its PTY, scrolls its scrollback and answers `prefix+/`. If placing a component requires the host to teach it anything, the component is not finished. AGENTS.md carries the widget/component guidance this belongs with.

═══ ARCHITECTURE DOCS — the authority, kept in the repo, not in planner prose ═══

- **`docs/surface-compositor.md`** — the surface-tree model deciding which layers and buttons are interactive. AGENTS.md already flags it as **required reading before adding any layer, surface, overlay/modal, exposé, or a button on a new surface**.
- **`docs/input-architecture.md`** — the one-tree input model: the 16 hand-written per-surface dispatch functions, the missing input pass for ordinary layers, the two rejected alternatives and why, and the plugin-overlay plumbing-vs-capability split. The authoritative spec for **P097**.
- **`docs/hint-architecture.md`** — the picker and letter model. ⚠️ It currently asserts "No second dispatch path", which is **false today** and becomes true only when P097 lands. Correct it as part of that phase.
- **`docs/widgets.md`** — the widget catalog and recipes.
- **`docs/overlay-design.md`** — overlay/modal design, including a pointer-routing section that predates the current code; verify before trusting it.

⚠️ These four docs describe overlapping ground and are free to drift — that is how `covers_content` came to be honoured by the action router and ignored by the hint walk, blanking every letter in the app. **P097 folds the input model into `docs/surface-compositor.md`** so there is one voice rather than four, and corrects the stale claim in `docs/hint-architecture.md`.

Linked here at the feature rather than only on a phase: a phase completes and becomes history, while anyone working anywhere in F003 needs these.
